Days per month for the daily rate
rows.description: The final settlement prices a day as the monthly basic salary divided by this.

rows.name: Severance, days per year of service
rows.description: Days of pay per year of service on dismissal, redundancy or retirement, from the law or the collective agreement.

rows.name: Notice, free days a week to look for a job
rows.description: Paid days the person may take each week of the notice to look for a new job.

rows.name: CNPS pension, employee share
rows.description: Withheld from elements subject to CNPS, up to the ceiling.

rows.name: CNPS pension, employer share
rows.description: On elements subject to CNPS, up to the ceiling.

rows.name: CNPS ceiling, per month
rows.description: CNPS contributions stop at this monthly pay.

rows.name: CNPS family benefits, employer
rows.description: On elements subject to CNPS, up to the ceiling.

rows.name: CNPS work accidents, employer
rows.description: By the company's risk group (1.75, 2.5 or 5), up to the ceiling.

rows.name: Crédit foncier, employee share
rows.description: Withheld from the taxable pay.

rows.name: Crédit foncier, employer share
rows.description: On the taxable pay.

rows.name: FNE (national employment fund)
rows.description: Employer, on the taxable pay.

rows.name: CAC (additional council tax)
rows.description: Withheld on top of the IRPP, as a share of it.

rows.name: IRPP professional deduction
rows.description: Taken off the yearly taxable pay before the bands.

rows.name: IRPP yearly allowance
rows.description: Taken off the yearly taxable pay after the professional deduction.

rows.name: IRPP: no tax below this monthly pay
rows.description: A taxable pay below this amount a month owes no IRPP.

rows.name: Minimum wage (SMIG), per month
rows.description: Basic pay may not fall below this monthly amount; checked, not paid.

rows.name: Loan deductions, at most
rows.description: Loan and advance installments together may take at most this share of the net pay; the rest waits.

rows.name: Child in charge, age limit
rows.description: A child stops counting for family allowances and the tax reduction at this age, unless studying full time or disabled. Empty: no age check.

rows.name: Child studying full time, age limit
rows.description: A child who studies full time counts until this age. A disabled child counts without age limit.

rows.name: Productivity
rows.description: Volume of work done against what was expected.

rows.name: Quality of work
rows.description: Accuracy, care and few corrections needed.

rows.name: Teamwork
rows.description: Helps colleagues, shares information, respects others.

rows.name: Punctuality
rows.description: From attendance: 100 less 5 points per late day and 10 per absent day.

rows.name: Administrator
rows.description: Platform configuration, users and roles

rows.name: Human resources
rows.description: Employees, schedules, payroll

rows.name: Finance
rows.description: Payroll approval and finance reports

rows.name: Manager
rows.description: Team attendance, approvals and evaluations

rows.name: Employee
rows.description: Own attendance, leave and payslips
